study_archetype: methodological PhD work on Gaussian process active learning for reliability analysis

reported_items.raw_name: Objective: reduce numerical cost of reliability analysis via GP active learning
reported_items.sub_category: reduce computational cost / improve reliability estimation

reported_items.raw_name: Study design: development/assessment of methodological improvements (two improvement paths)
Data or sample: use of sample population for failure probability estimation (classification of a sample)
reported_items.sub_category: population sample for classification-based failure probability estimation

reported_items.raw_name: Methods: Gaussian process based active learning to build GP surrogate of performance function
reported_items.sub_category: Gaussian process surrogate with active learning focused near limit state

reported_items.raw_name: Methods: two improvement paths — (1) characterization/inclusion of estimation errors in learning algorithm, (2) coupling active learning with model order reduction
reported_items.sub_category: error characterization and model order reduction coupling

reported_items.raw_name: Outcomes: aim to decrease number of expensive model calls while maintaining accurate failure probability estimates
reported_items.sub_category: reduced model calls with maintained estimation accuracy
